title: report_upload
description: Body of POST /reports, sent after the photo was PUT to the presigned URL. The worker also writes one for each frame it cuts from a scan video. The server re-checks everything; hints from the phone are never trusted.

upload_id.description: From POST /uploads/presign. The report id reuses its suffix: upl_x becomes rpt_x, so a retried POST is idempotent.

context.description: Allowed values depend on report_type; see allOf.

capture_mode.description: snap: one photo, sent by the phone. scan: a frame the worker cut from a scan video (decision 20261010-0203).

scan.description: Set by the worker on every scan frame; the phone never sends it. Required when capture_mode is scan, forbidden when it is snap. gps is interpolated from the scan's gps_track at t_ms, and captured_at is started_at plus t_ms.

t_ms.description: Frame time from the start of the video.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original image bytes, computed on the phone, lowercase hex.

accuracy_m.description: Reported GPS accuracy radius in metres.

device_token.description: Per-device token: a random UUID v4 the app creates once and keeps in IndexedDB. Keys reputation and rate limits.

captured_at.description: When the camera took the photo, ISO 8601 UTC.

user_id.description: Cognito sub of the signed-in reporter, opaque (decision 20261010-0227). The api sets it from the verified token and ignores any value the phone sends; scan frames copy it from the scan session. Absent only on guest reports made before accounts.

note.description: Optional free text. Moderated for toxicity and personal data before it is shown.

me_too_site_id.description: Set when the reporter tapped Me too on this site. The merger still checks distance and type.

hints.description: Phone-side model output, present only in edge mode; for a scan frame, the worker copies the phone detection at that frame. Hints for live boxes and frame selection only; never used as evidence.

recall_audit.description: True for the 1-in-20 confident-empty frame uploaded for recall audits.

then.description: Decision 20261010-1630: a no_bin report says there is no dustbin within 1 km of where the reporter stands. The photo is optional: without sha256 there is no photo; upload_id is then made by the app (upl_ plus a lowercase ULID).
